history.sg_progress: UNAMI has shared its inventory of 593 non-expendable Field Technology Section assets with the United Nations Logistics Base at Brindisi, Italy, and other United Nations missions. Based on the expression of interest by missions, asset transfers are proceeding in accordance with established procedures. The preliminary asset disposal plan, which is aligned with current asset disposal practices, has been submitted to the United Nations Logistics Base and issuance of the final asset disposal plan is pending. Remaining disposal activities, including shipments to the United Nations Logistics Base and other missions, are fully planned within the overarching disposal framework. These efforts are being carried out in close coordination with the United Nations Logistics Base, ensuring compliance with United Nations standards and operational continuity. The Mission has concluded a service-level agreement with the United Nations Logistics Base and a kick-off meeting for its implementation was held on 15 July 2025. Given the structured implementation plan, clear timelines and alignment with established procedures, the Mission considers this recommendation to be implemented and requests its closure by the Board.
